purpose: Freeze the evidence and limitations behind the bounded XCAT-v2 frame-1 field-layout and coordinate contract without packaging the external generator executable.

generator_static_analysis.method: ELF symbol-table inspection and x86-64 disassembly of the content-identified external executable

empirical_endian_canary.purpose: Corroborate little-endian float decoding independently of file-size checks; this canary does not establish axis order.
empirical_endian_canary.interpretation: The little-endian value is an exact integral XCAT structure code; the big-endian interpretation is an implausible denormal.

axis_direction.authority: XCAT parameter-file notes describing the x, y, and z axes
axis_direction.convention_limit: No RAS or LPS convention is claimed.

parameter_file_authority.startslice_note_behavior: A value of zero is just below the feet and increasing values move toward the head.

authoritative_field_grid_contract.registration_authority: content-identified XCAT-v2 generator reverse engineering plus parameter-file coordinate contract

raw_coordinate_behavior.observed_behavior_for_startslice_1: x and y use the centered physical generator coordinates; z is output-local and increases from the feet toward the head.
raw_coordinate_behavior.import_behavior: Finite RAW coordinates are preserved without inferred axis permutation; source triangles are materialized as array-free vtkPolyData.
raw_coordinate_behavior.evidence_basis: generator/parameter contract corroborated by frame-1 occupied-field-to-RAW bounding-box diagnostics

field_value_semantics.activ_output_format_0: numbered activity BIN values are stored as float32
field_value_semantics.color_code_1: each structure is written using its unique XCAT structure code rather than physiological activity
field_value_semantics.activity_unit_0: no voxel-volume activity scaling is applied

frame_1_bbox_diagnostic_observations.interpretation: The close fit supports plausibility for this frame-1 cohort, but the diagnostic transform is constructed from the same occupied and RAW bounds and is not independent registration evidence.

known_limits_and_fail_closed_rules.limit: Every frozen cohort case has X==Y dimensions.
known_limits_and_fail_closed_rules.consequence: Dimensions and axis-aligned bounds cannot empirically distinguish an x/y permutation.
known_limits_and_fail_closed_rules.authority_retained: The unswapped x/y mapping relies on generator reverse engineering and parameter-file axis notes.

known_limits_and_fail_closed_rules.limit: The headerless origin and x-fastest order are not established by a vendor-published format specification.
known_limits_and_fail_closed_rules.consequence: They remain explicitly tied to the content-identified generator executable and its reverse-engineered SAVE_TO_FILE behavior.

known_limits_and_fail_closed_rules.limit: The occupied-field-to-RAW bounding-box fit is constructed from the compared bounds.
known_limits_and_fail_closed_rules.consequence: Its near-zero constructed residual is numerical self-consistency, not an independent registration result.

known_limits_and_fail_closed_rules.limit: Only startslice=1 has bounded RAW/BIN z-origin evidence.
known_limits_and_fail_closed_rules.consequence: startslice!=1 is unsupported and must fail closed until an independent fixture establishes its output-local z origin.

known_limits_and_fail_closed_rules.limit: The empirical endian canary observes one scalar in one frame-1 source field.
known_limits_and_fail_closed_rules.consequence: It corroborates byte order but does not independently establish axis order, origin, or temporal generality.

known_limits_and_fail_closed_rules.limit: The empirical bounding-box observations cover frame 1 only.
known_limits_and_fail_closed_rules.consequence: They do not establish registration or layout generality across all 51 frames.

readiness_effect.supports: bounded XCAT-v2 frame-1 source import and runtime-persistence evaluation
